##Setup
```{r}
library(data.table)
library(ggplot2)
final <- read.csv("nhl_2025_26_player_shift_data.csv")
setorder(shift_ivl, shift_id, interval_start)
shift_strength <- shift_ivl[, .(strength = first(strength)), by = shift_id]
```



#Building Shift Elapsed Time
```{r}
setDT(final)
setorder(final, game_id, player_id, period, interval_start)

# a new shift starts whenever there's a gap in interval_start
# (or it's the player's very first interval in that period)
final[, gap := interval_start - shift(interval_start, 1L, type = "lag"),
      by = .(game_id, player_id, period)]
final[, new_shift := is.na(gap) | gap > 5]
final[, shift_num := cumsum(new_shift), by = .(game_id, player_id, period)]

# time elapsed since THAT shift began (0-5, 5-10, 45-50, etc.)
final[, shift_start_time := min(interval_start),
      by = .(game_id, player_id, period, shift_num)]
final[, time_in_shift := interval_start - shift_start_time]

xgf_by_shift_time <- final[, .(mean_xGF = mean(xGF), n = .N), by = time_in_shift]
setorder(xgf_by_shift_time, time_in_shift)

#test
#xgf_by_shift_time[time_in_shift %in% seq(0, 150, 15)]
```


```{r}
setDT(final)
setorder(final, game_id, player_id, period, interval_start)

# a new shift starts whenever there's a gap in interval_start
# (or it's the player's very first interval in that period)
final[, gap := interval_start - shift(interval_start, 1L, type = "lag"),
      by = .(game_id, player_id, period)]
final[, new_shift := is.na(gap) | gap > 5]
final[, shift_num := cumsum(new_shift), by = .(game_id, player_id, period)]

# time elapsed since THAT shift began (0-5, 5-10, 45-50, etc.)
final[, shift_start_time := min(interval_start),
      by = .(game_id, player_id, period, shift_num)]
final[, time_in_shift := interval_start - shift_start_time]

xgf_by_shift_time <- final[, .(mean_xGF = mean(xGF), n = .N), by = time_in_shift]
setorder(xgf_by_shift_time, time_in_shift)

#test
#xgf_by_shift_time[time_in_shift %in% seq(0, 150, 15)]
```

#Plot 5 on 5


```{r}
xgf_by_shift_time_5v5 <- final[strength == "PP" & has_stoppage == FALSE,
                                .(mean_xGF = mean(xGF), n = .N),
                                by = time_in_shift]
setorder(xgf_by_shift_time_5v5, time_in_shift)

xga_by_shift_time_5v5 <- final[strength == "PP" & has_stoppage == FALSE,
                                .(mean_xGA = mean(xGA), n = .N),
                                by = time_in_shift]
setorder(xga_by_shift_time_5v5, time_in_shift)

xg_margin_by_shift_time_5v5 <- merge(
  xgf_by_shift_time_5v5[, .(time_in_shift, mean_xGF, n)],
  xga_by_shift_time_5v5[, .(time_in_shift, mean_xGA)],
  by = "time_in_shift"
)

xg_margin_by_shift_time_5v5[, xg_margin := mean_xGF - mean_xGA]
setorder(xg_margin_by_shift_time_5v5, time_in_shift)

#xgf_by_shift_time_5v5[time_in_shift %in% seq(0, 150, 15)]  # table

combined <- rbind(
  xgf_by_shift_time_5v5[, .(time_in_shift, value = mean_xGF, metric = "xGF")],
  xga_by_shift_time_5v5[, .(time_in_shift, value = mean_xGA, metric = "xGA")]
)

ggplot(combined[time_in_shift <= 120],
       aes(x = time_in_shift, y = value, color = metric)) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 1) +
  geom_point(size = 1.5) +
  scale_color_manual(values = c("xGF" = "steelblue", "xGA" = "firebrick")) +
  labs(
    title = "Average xGF vs xGA by Time on Ice (5-on-5 only)",
    x = "Seconds into current shift",
    y = "Average value per 5-second interval",
    color = NULL
  ) +
  theme_bw()

ggplot(xg_margin_by_shift_time_5v5[time_in_shift <= 90],
       aes(x = time_in_shift, y = xg_margin)) +
  geom_line(color = "darkgreen", linewidth = 1) +
  geom_point(size = 1.5, color = "darkgreen") +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", color = "grey50") +
  labs(
    title = "xG Margin by Time on Ice (5-on-5 only)",
    x = "Seconds into current shift",
    y = "xGF − xGA per 5-second interval"
  ) +
  theme_bw()
```
